purpose: Test whether paired uniform-versus-clustered dimensionless adhesion force contrasts are robust to alternative sliding laws; prioritize molecular measurements, not fit molecular results.
model: New small-strain 2D diluted triangular lattice with a cell cavity, elastic collinear bending, per-edge standard-linear-solid sliding branches, quasi-static force balance and backward-Euler internal-state updates. Related to the prior cavity network; not a rerun of the earlier H100 periodic bulk-strain model.
units: dimensionless; base lattice spacing, branch stiffness, and background sliding time set the units; no cell-timescale mapping or pN prediction
cell_loading: actin displacement ramp 0 to 0.04 lattice units over 1 time unit, hold to 5, unload to 6, recover to 10
bulk_matching: Each architecture scaled to the same graph's all-unmodified instantaneous shear energy; scale elastic, sliding, yield and viscous forces together, retaining chosen time ratios. Only initial shear stiffness matched, not all tensor components or relaxed stiffness.
cluster_position: 35 percent nearest edges to a cell-adjacent center at radius 1.6; angle rotates by seed in 45-degree steps; paired uniform selection has same count and same diluted graph
primary_metric: mean adhesion spring/reaction magnitude integrated over the hold t=1..5, expressed as symmetric paired contrast 2*(cluster-uniform)/(cluster+uniform)
uncertainty: Pointwise paired geometry-seed bootstrap 4000 resamples, fixed seed 81271; intervals describe model-seed variability, not biological uncertainty. No prior probability over law/parameter space; robustness fractions are design coverage only.
decision_rule: Call a parameter scenario direction-resolved only if its paired-bootstrap interval excludes zero. A universal topology direction requires no direction-resolved sign reversals over screened laws and parameters. Report unresolved/small effects, not just sign counts. Practical small-effect band +/-0.05 symmetric contrast is a declared screening tolerance, not a biological threshold.
checks: exact law/selection-null when stiffness ratio and time ratio are one
compute: Original C++ solver and Python standard-library analysis on laptop CPU; no new dependency, remote execution, H100 interruption, provisioning, or GPU cost. Preserve results and source checksums.
